title: Behind the local-AI cluster batch one
description: Three new local-AI guides shipped together: quantization sizing, resident embeddings, and a local retrieval walkthrough, each linked into the glossary and the topic hub.
lead: The first cluster batch adds three long guides that fit the existing templates: which quantization level for which card, how to keep embeddings resident on a consumer GPU, and a full local retrieval walkthrough. Each guide links to its cluster siblings and the topic hub, each glossary term links back, and the deterministic build plus the full test suite pass.
merge_note: Merge pending; the merge SHA is recorded here after release approval and merge.

reasoning.DEV: The three guides were drafted from the existing post template with every memory and speed figure tied to a primary source.
